name_reason: Name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=composite/gfx, descriptor=battle_frame) and accurately reflects the function's role as the battle screen frame finalizer/compositor. No Ghidra address residue in the name. No domain ID involved.
purpose: Battle screen frame finalizer: composite the tile map, cursor overlay, character/enemy sprites, and terrain-info HUD into the render workspace, then blit the visible 312x192 region to the mode13h primary surface.
logic_summary: 1) fd2_tick_chapter_palette_animation() advances the chapter-tied palette anim counter. 2) If skip_palette_cycle==0, fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim() applies cyclic palette rotation (water/torch). 3) ws = data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr + 0x8088 (render back-buffer). 4) fd2_composite_battle_tile_map(ws,456,13,8,origin_x,origin_y) paints the 13x8-tile tilemap. 5) fd2_paint_cursor_overlay_pattern() composites the tile-cursor highlight. 6) fd2_composite_all_chars_overlay() composites all live character/enemy sprites. 7) fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel(ws,456) paints the terrain-info HUD. 8) fd2_blit_rectangle(0xA0504,320,ws,456,312,192) blits the composite to mode13h primary (dst stride 320). The __CHK call is the Watcom stack-probe prologue (no game logic).

params.name: skip_palette_cycle
params.semantics: 0 = advance the cyclic palette rotation this frame (call fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim); non-zero = skip the cycle advance (used inside animation loops where the caller drives palette timing). The chapter palette anim counter advances unconditionally regardless of this flag.
params.reason: Source param name skip_palette_cycle accurately describes the flag's effect (gating the fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim call) and carries no address residue. Ghidra decompile shows generic 'param_1' but the home-file declaration already uses skip_palette_cycle; no rename needed.
